date_in_force.why: The legislature page says 'EFFECTIVE May 17, 2024' and the safety clause makes the act effective on signature, so the quote supports 2024-05-17; but the duties were deferred to 30 Jun 2026 and the act was then repealed and reenacted, so a reader may expect a later date. The notes explain it.

status.why: SB 26-189 (signed 14 May 2026, effective 1 Jan 2027) repeals and reenacts part 17, so Superseded is defensible; the extractor's open question about whether the old duties applied between 30 Jun 2026 and 1 Jan 2027 is a human call.
